verification.verification_description: First periodic verification of the Mida Creek Mangrove Restoration Project, covering the 2023 monitoring period. SCS Global Services conducted a site audit at Mida Creek from 2024-02-05 to 2024-02-12, led by Grace Wanjiku as lead verifier, and reviewed the monitoring report, plot-level biomass measurements from 42 permanent sample plots, soil organic carbon sampling, and remote sensing evidence of canopy cover change. Net verified removals of 52,300 tCO2e were confirmed from 66,200 tCO2e of gross monitored removals, after a 5% uncertainty deduction of 3,310 tCO2e, a leakage deduction of 1,150 tCO2e, and a buffer pool contribution of 9,440 tCO2e. The verified quantity corresponds to issuance batch cdop:KEN:VCS-4721:B1. One Forward Action Request was raised regarding documentation of plot re-measurement intervals. All quantities, identifiers, signature payloads, and dates in this record are hypothetical.
verification.verification_leakage_risk_mitigation_str: Activity-shifting leakage is monitored across a 5 km belt surrounding the project area using annual high-resolution imagery and household fuelwood surveys. Alternative fuelwood woodlots and improved cookstoves were provided to the three adjacent communities to reduce displacement of harvesting pressure. See section 6.4 of the monitoring report: https://registry.verra.org/app/projectDetail/VCS/4721/monitoring

status.verification_audit_checkpoint_status: Pass with reservations (Approved, but with Forward Action Requests / FARs)
status.verification_audit_checkpoint_status_rea: One Forward Action Request was raised regarding documentation of plot re-measurement intervals. The finding did not affect the verified quantity and was scheduled for closure at the next periodic verification.
The Forward Action Request was closed during the 2025 verification, after the project developer documented revised plot re-measurement intervals in the monitoring plan.

verification.verification_description: Second periodic verification of the Mida Creek Mangrove Restoration Project, covering the 2024 monitoring period. SCS Global Services conducted a site audit from 2025-02-03 to 2025-02-10, again led by Grace Wanjiku as lead verifier, and reviewed the monitoring report, the second round of plot re-measurements, soil organic carbon sampling, and annual change detection over the project area and the 5 km reference region. Net verified removals of 54,800 tCO2e were confirmed from 69,000 tCO2e of gross monitored removals, after a 5% uncertainty deduction of 3,450 tCO2e, a leakage deduction of 1,290 tCO2e, and a buffer pool contribution of 9,460 tCO2e. The verified quantity corresponds to issuance batch cdop:KEN:VCS-4721:B2, and the two buffer pool contributions together make up the 18,900 tCO2e of cumulative deposits recorded in the project durability record. The Forward Action Request raised at the 2024 verification was closed. All quantities, identifiers, signature payloads, and dates in this record are hypothetical.
verification.verification_leakage_risk_mitigation_str: Leakage monitoring continued across the 5 km belt surrounding the project area, combining annual high-resolution imagery with household fuelwood surveys in the three adjacent communities. Uptake of the alternative fuelwood woodlots and improved cookstoves was reassessed during the site audit, and the slightly higher deduction reflects increased harvesting pressure recorded in the northern belt. See section 6.4 of the monitoring report: https://registry.verra.org/app/projectDetail/VCS/4721/monitoring

status.verification_audit_checkpoint_status_rea: No new findings were raised, and the Forward Action Request carried over from the 2024 verification was closed after the project developer documented revised plot re-measurement intervals.
